clips.name: crayon-scribbling
clips.prompt: Close-up of a wax crayon scribbling little doodles on textured paper. Soft dry grainy strokes, short irregular back-and-forth movements, tiny pauses. Gentle and intimate, quiet room, no voices, no music, no sharp impacts.

clips.name: happy-return-chime
clips.prompt: A tiny warm toy bell welcome chime, softly rising with a happy relieved feeling, like a teddy bear greeting a returning friend. Delicate rounded music-box tones with a short gentle decay into silence. No voices, no dramatic swell, no harsh attack.
